what: When a title line (vertical column or horizontal line) enters the screen, it sharpens in 1s from a 5px blur, transparent, with a staggered 10px up/down offset. It starts at .3s with each line .1s later, odd lines from below and even lines from above. Side text such as 【label】 and English subtitles has no position shift, only the blur clears at .6s. Plays once

options.shift: Stagger distance in px, default 10 — 0 means blur only, in place
options.look: no-fade: The row’s opacity turns on immediately and only the blur and position clear away (City subpage first heading #layer_ttl: transition-property translate, filter)
options.[data-fx-part=soft]: Side text where only the blur clears (label, subtitle)
options.class=\"fx-bl-wait\": If the hero title is attached in markup beforehand, it is hidden before it is painted, so it does not flicker (the original STUDIO also puts .appear in markup)
options.ease: Curve (CSS form), default cubic-bezier(.07,.36,.66,.97) — the original’s power2.inOut is cubic-bezier(.455,.03,.515,.955)
options.enter: Position where unveiling starts — when the top edge of the row group reaches this % from the top of the screen (default 100 = as soon as it appears). brand 70
options.leave: Where it hides again on replay — once the bottom edge rises past this % from the top of the screen (default 0). brand 50
options.replay: 1 fades again when leaving the enter~leave band and clears each time it enters (default is once only)

use: 【Label】First lineSecond row
